prompt: Using the same $f(x) = x + 4$ and $g(x) = 3x$, find $g(f(2))$.
hint: This time $f$ is on the inside, so $f$ runs FIRST.

hints.text: This time $f$ is on the inside, so $f$ runs FIRST.

explanation: The inside machine always goes first. Here that is $f$.
$g(6) = 18$. Notice this is NOT the same as $f(g(2)) = 10$ — order matters.

alternativeExplanations.title: Swap the machines on the belt
steps: Put the "add 4" machine first: 2 goes in, 6 comes out.
Then the "triple it" machine: 6 goes in, 18 comes out.
Same two machines, different order, different answer.
